text:
maria: taking over evening shift now. running quick check — any active P1s?
aj: nothing P1 right now. we did get a pager for redis timeouts at 21:05 but resolved by autoscale.
kal: saw that, logs show transient queue spike. added a temporary route rule.
jess: leaving primary on-call to maria, I can stay secondary until 22:30 for overlap.
maria: thanks. can you confirm who is comms for tonight if something customer-facing pops? need someone to own notifications.
jess: I can do comms for the first hour, then if anything persists, we should escalate to @kal.
aj: note a coverage gap 02:00-03:00 UTC tomorrow — our APAC rotation hasn't got a backup. flagged in pager schedule: https://internal.redwood/schedule.
kal: yeah that gap is still open. I can pick it up but need confirmation from rotations lead. tagging @ops-lead (not in thread) to approve.
incident-bot: PAGERS: redis-timeouts (resolved) — incident #INC-2026 closed.
maria: runbook pointer — redis timeouts troubleshooting is at https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/redis-timeouts. key steps: check node CPU, slowlog, and prefix cache hits.
aj: if it looks like broker backlog, follow the 'drain-broker' snippet:```bash
kubectl scale deployment broker --replicas=0
sleep 30
kubectl scale deployment broker --replicas=2
```
kal: also FYI, metrics dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/ops/redis-overview — set timeframe to last 15m.
jess: for customer comms template use: "We’re aware of intermittent API timeouts affecting inference requests. Our team is investigating and will provide updates every 15 minutes." copy available in #status-templates.
maria: plan for tonight: primary=maria (drive), secondary=aj (support), comms=jess until 22:30 then kal if needed, escalate path: paging → bridge → on-call manager.
aj: ack. I'll monitor error budget and token queue. if error rate >2% over 5m I will trigger canary rollback and ring the bridge.
kal: added a quick note in the shift doc: https://wiki.redwood/shifts/evening-2026 — marked coverage gap and escalation contacts.
jess: leaving thread, ping me in DMs if you need me to post a customer update. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all. if anything immediate pages me: I'll open a bridge and post the link here. otherwise doing a checklist run (quick health, infra, model-serving).
incident-bot: BRIDGE CREATED by maria — https://meet.redwood/bridge/BR-2113456789
maria: opening bridge now and running through runbook steps 1-3. anyone joining the bridge?
aj: jumping in the bridge in 30s.
kal: standing by, will join if bridge shows errors on GPU nodes.
jen: (not listed earlier but joined) can take slack comms if jess gets pulled into exec update.
maria: perfect — good coverage. closing the thread for handoff; will update if anything changes.
